productOnPage.title: Yoto Classics Collection
productOnPage.author: Various
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Immerse yourself in a world of imagination, adventure and self-discovery in this collection of classics, retold by Yoto. The perfect collection for introducing your little one to literary classics.   Adapted by Yoto, these timeless novels have been brought to life for a new generation with music, sound effects and a dynamic cast. From buried treasure, to yellow brick roads, and tales of friendship and sisterhood, the whole family can indulge in these beloved stories that have stood the test of time.    This collection includes:   The Wonderful Wizard of OzLittle WomenThe Jungle BookTreasure IslandA Little Princess Tracks included: Chapter 1 Chapter 2 Chapter 3 Chapter 4 Chapter 5 Chapter 6 Chapter 7 Chapter 8 Chapter 9 Chapter 10 Chapter 11 Chapter 12 Chapter 13 Chapter 14 Chapter 15 Chapter 16 Chapter 17 Chapter 18 Chapter 19 Chapter 20

yotoCreatorModal.body:
#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
